title: Usage and cost
description: Where the money and capacity go, split by what each app and database actually uses. This is showback of your own prices, not an invoice.

summary.forecastHint: Based on the last few full days of spend.
summary.unallocatedHint: Idle capacity nobody used. It is shown here instead of being hidden inside app costs.

table.label: Cost ranking
table.name: Name
table.empty: Nothing to show for this period yet.

movers.title: Biggest movers
movers.none: No resource changed its cost since the previous period.

empty.notConfiguredTitle: Set your prices to see costs
empty.notConfiguredDescription: Usage is already being recorded. Enter what a server costs you, or a price per vCPU and GiB hour, and every app gets a cost.
empty.notConfiguredAskAdmin: Ask an instance admin to set prices. Usage is already being recorded.
empty.noTelemetryDescription: Cost needs the metrics collector. Turn on observability to record per app CPU and memory.

unpriced: {{nodes}} has no price yet, so apps running there are not costed.

settings.title: Prices and allocation
settings.description: Costs are your own prices applied to measured usage. Each day is priced when it is recorded, so changing prices does not rewrite history unless you ask for the month to date to be repriced.
settings.modeNodeHint: Enter what each server costs per month. The bill is shared between apps by how much of the server they used.
settings.modeUnitHint: Enter a price per vCPU hour and GiB hour. Useful when there is no single bill to split.
settings.storage: Per GiB of volume storage per month
settings.presetHint: Illustrative prices of a common VPS size. Correct them to what you pay.
settings.idle: Share of idle capacity to spread over apps
settings.idleHintNode: 0 shows all idle capacity as Unallocated. 100 spreads it over apps by usage so the report adds up to the whole bill.
settings.idleHintUnit: Added on top of each app's cost as headroom overhead.
settings.weight: Part of a server bill attributed to CPU
settings.weightHint: The rest is attributed to memory.
settings.reprice: Also reprice the month to date
settings.repriceHint: Recomputes days already recorded this month with these prices.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.description: A monthly limit for a project or a team. Alerts go through your notification channels when a budget reaches its warning level, goes over, or is forecast to overrun.
budgets.alertHint: Create a budget_threshold alert rule so these reach your channels.
